name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 23, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Virtual presentation of Certificates of Appreciation to volunteers that distributed facial coverings at the beach
4B.
Virtual presentation of the Clean Air Day Proclamation
4C.
Coastal Rail Trail – Santa Fe Drive to E Street Segment Update presented by SANDAG
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the September 9, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-09-23 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-09-23 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Authorize grant applications for Highway Safety Improvement Program (HSIP) Grant Cycle 10. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1)Santa Fe Drive & Balour Drive Traffic Signal; 2) Coast Highway 101 Striping Modifications between Swami’s and Chesterfield Drive; 3) Coast Highway 101 Pedestrian improvements between Chesterfield Drive and Solana Beach; and 4)Citywide Traffic Signal Improvements and Lead Pedestrian Interval (LPI) Implementation.
2020-09-23 Item 08C Cycle 10 HSIP Grant Authorization
8D.
Contract award for Construction of Five Concrete Sculpture Pedestals. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
1) Award Bid for the Construction of Five Concrete Sculpture Pedestals to Tri-Group Construction and Development, Inc; 2) Authorize the Interim City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report in the amount of $29,900 and a ten percent (10%) contingency of $2,990 for the project in the event that additional work is needed, for a project total not to exceed $32,890; and 3) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-82, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report to allocate $3,290 to the Construction of Five Concrete Sculpture Pedestals Construction Improvement Project (CIP) CP20A.
2020-09-23 Item 08D Contract Award for Construction of Five Concrete Sculpture Pedestals
8E.
Contract for Annual Street Sweeping Services. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
1) Adopt Resolution 2020-72 authorizing the City to proceed with awarding a contract for street sweeping services pursuant to a piggyback contract in accordance with a competitive procurement conducted by the City of Redlands as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; and 2) Authorize the City Manager in consultation with the City Attorney to execute a six-year street sweeping services contract with Cannon Pacific Services, Inc. dba Pacific Sweeping (Cannon) in substantial form in the amount not to exceed $1,882,363 as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report.
2020-09-23 Item 08E Contract for Annual Street Sweeping Services
8F.
Approval of Memorandum of Understanding with North County Transit District for Concrete Ditch Extension from La Costa Avenue to Ashbury Street, approve plans and specifications and award of construction contract for the North Vulcan Avenue Temporary Parking and Drainage Improvements - Phase 2 Project (CS21B), and adopt budget resolution. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the North County Transit District (NCTD) for the concrete ditch extension from La Costa Avenue toward Ashbury Street in substantial conformance as shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; 2) Approve the plans and specifications for the North Vulcan Avenue temporary Parking and Drainage Improvements - Phase 2 Project; 3) Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Sierra Pacific West in the amount of $459,212 plus 26 percent contingency ($119,395) to construct the North Vulcan Avenue Temporary Parking and Drainage Improvements - Phase 2 Project, for the base bid plus alternates 1 and 2, for a total construction contract not-to-exceed amount of $578,607; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-77, entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget" (Attachment 3 of the agenda report) to allocate $230,128 to the North Vulcan Avenue Temporary Parking and Drainage Improvements Project (CS21B).
2020-09-23 Item 08F MOU with NCTD N Vulcan Improvements Phase 2
9.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF CITY COUNCIL IS OCTOBER 14, 2020.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
